lines.en: Stares at you for a long time.

lines.zh: 脚几乎不动，却挪了半寸。
lines.en: My feet barely move, yet I shift an inch.

lines.zh: 根须拖着躯体缓缓移动。
lines.en: Roots drag my body slowly forward.

lines.zh: 我像一段长着眼睛的树桩。
lines.en: I am like a tree stump with eyes.

lines.zh: 眼白多过瞳孔，一直睁着。
lines.en: More white than pupil, my eyes never close.
I hold one pose until sunset.
Tree shadows crawl across my back.
Even the wind goes around me.
I blink once in a very long while.

lines.zh: 我把自己当成一截枯木。
lines.en: I take myself for a dead stump.
Footsteps far off; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我的眼白比瞳孔多，转过来。
lines.en: My whites outnumber my pupils; I turn them on you.

lines.zh: 我不动，只有眼珠跟着你。
lines.en: I stay still; only my eyeballs follow you.

lines.zh: 我不动，只用眼睛跟着你。
lines.en: I do not move; only my eyes follow you.

lines.zh: 你把枯叶踩响，我偏了偏头。
lines.en: You crack the dead leaves; I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 凝视着你的每一个动作。
林间四只凝视，都朝向你。
lines.en: Four stares in the woods all turn toward you.
Under my stare, you slow to a halt.

lines.zh: 我眨眼的时候，你最好跑。
lines.en: When I blink, you had better run.
Get closer and I'll become a spark!
Touch me, and shine you will!
Get close, and I'll surround you with light!
The closer you are, the brighter I am!
Get close, and the light will guide you!

lines.zh: 靠近我，光芒指引你前行！
lines.en: Get close, and the light will lead you!

lines.zh: 你再靠近些，我就会发光！
lines.en: Get a bit closer, and I'll glow!
Get close, and the light will shine!

lines.zh: 我不动，可我的眼睛跟着你。
lines.en: I do not move, but my eyes follow you.
Don't bump into me, it'll hurt!
Don't touch me, I'm easy to break!
Don't touch me, I'm easy to break!
Be careful, touching me will shatter me!
Touch me, and you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你就动不了了。
lines.en: One bump and you cannot move.

lines.zh: 找个伴侣，我就可以繁衍！
lines.en: Find a partner, and we can reproduce!

lines.zh: 两截枯木相望，根在土里缠。
lines.en: Two dead stumps face each other, roots twining in the soil.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我等的也是一双眼。
lines.en: In the birch grove I wait for another pair of eyes.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，我就可以繁殖！
lines.en: Find a mate, and we can reproduce!
Reproduction needs a mate, come on!
Two stares meet; the forest grows quieter.
It stares back; neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我触碰到了大地的气息。

lines.en: This is the scent of the forest.
My roots dig deep into the soil.

lines.zh: 我是这片土地的一部分。
lines.en: I am a part of this land.

lines.zh: 我是大地之歌的一部分。
lines.en: I am part of the earth's song.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枝，替我指了路。
lines.en: The twig you snapped points the way for me.
I barely step; I only stare.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，只守着这片林子。
lines.en: I barely move, guarding only this forest.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，可我看得见你。
lines.en: I hardly move, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 我会保护这里的每一寸土地。
lines.en: I will protect every inch of this land.
My roots dig deep into the earth.

lines.zh: 你将无法离开这片森林。
我的存在是这片森林的一部分。
lines.en: My being is a part of this forest.

lines.zh: 我将永远守护这片土地。
lines.en: I will forever protect this land.

lines.zh: 低吟一声，化为利刃直刺！
lines.en: A low growl, transforming into a blade.
Swinging branches, sharp as a blade.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，叶片割裂空气！
lines.en: Sibilant rustle, slicing through the air.
In the stare, a blade appears.
Forms quietly in the birch forest.
Spawns naturally in the flower forest.
Taking shape in the forest shadow.
Spawns in the forest depths, self-destructing.
Exists quietly in the birch forest.

lines.zh: 白桦林里多了一双眼睛。
lines.en: A new pair of eyes in the birch wood.
In groups of four, we show from the trees.

lines.zh: 我从树桩上倒下，脸先着地。
lines.en: I topple from my stump and land on my face.

lines.zh: 我站得太慢，连躲都省了。
lines.en: I move so slowly I do not even dodge.
Light burns across my eye whites, stinging.

lines.zh: 站着一动不动，饿得发晕。
